title: Can LLMs Discern the Traits Influencing Your Preferences? Evaluating Personality-Driven Preference Alignment in LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the asymmetry in LLM predictive performance and preference alignment between 'High' and 'Low' poles of Big Five personality traits, observing that models disproportionately fail on low-trait signals by conflating them with negative normative behavior due to safety and politeness constraints.

Evaluating the model's tendency to prefer affirmative or 'positive' choices over negative ones when reasoning about candidate answers, which disproportionately degrades performance for low-trait persona conditions.
